3781.title: Sender identity is omitted from dispatch admission
3781.rootCauseOneLine: The send path resolves senderThreadId for delivery but forwards null provenance into the public dispatch hook context.
3781.proposedFix: Define public message-origin semantics and pass the resolved sender into hook context, including queued retries.
3781.caveats: Server-service reproduction only; no live UI, CLI send, or provider. A public hook contract decision prevents an automatic simple fix.
